snippet.title: Trawler's Wake // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3676140/Trawlers_Wake

A cheap trip to a paradise harbor lands you in a rotten fishing town full of mutants, anomalies, and fish worth a fortune. Fish by day, sell your catch, upgrade your old trawler, dig up the story, and try not to kick the bucket after dark.

Developed by
Icebound Labs
